subject: EBP kickoff: energy-based processes -> 3D capture cleanup
body:
Hi all,

Kicking off the EBP effort. Our open-source Energy-Based Processes release showed EBPs capture multi-modality on exchangeable data where GPs, Neural Processes, and Variational Implicit Processes flatten it out. The product thesis: point-cloud denoising with the learned energy function is exactly what our 3D capture partners need for cleaning noisy scans, with point-cloud generation via the RNN sampler as a second act.

Milestones inside our window (Mar 16 - Jul 6): image-completion sanity demo on MNIST-style conditioning by mid-April, point-cloud denoising eval on partner-shaped data by May 22, Launch Review Board slot in the second half of June.

Alina owns staffing and the compute plan - note the codebase needs gcc plus CUDA builds, so let's get the toolchain sorted early rather than the night before a run.

Questions welcome, otherwise let's move.

Lucia
